title: PongGame Message Envelope
description: Standard envelope required for every event and command exchanged through RabbitMQ.

messageId.description: Unique identifier of this message, used for idempotent processing.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID tracing the distributed flow across services.

type.description: Logical event or command type (e.g., match.created, match.ready, match.finished).

occurredAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the message was produced.

payload.description: Event-specific payload matching the corresponding contract schema.
